blurb: Guests can shoot at a state-of-the-art indoor range with 15 lanes and 25-yard distances. The facility offers a wide selection of rental firearms and ammunition, private lessons, youth firearm safety classes, and firearm transfers. Certified instructors provide training and supervision, including a youth safety class where children learn firearm safety and shoot for the first time with a parent present.
